name: Cheesy Pasta Marinara with Roasted Edamame, Mushrooms & Bell Pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; medium dice. Transfer to a baking dish.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the baking dish with the bell pepper along with mushrooms and edamame. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
1 (227 g) pkg sliced white mushrooms
1 cup edamame, shelled
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until veggies are just tender, 10-15 minutes.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Cover and set aside to keep warm.
When the veggies are tender, remove from oven. Pour marinara sauce over the veggies, stir to combine, and spread out in an even layer. Sprinkle with cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (680 g) jar marinara sauce
½ cup shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Return baking dish to the oven and continue to bake until sauce is warmed through and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Add the veggie sauce to the pot with the pasta and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
